name: Swiftfin Enhanced
subtitle: Swiftfin with real-time Anime4K Metal enhancement
description: An unofficial personal Swiftfin fork that follows Jellyfin upstream and adds an iOS/iPadOS Enhanced player. Builds are produced automatically from public source code.

apps.name: Swiftfin Enhanced
apps.subtitle: Jellyfin playback with Anime4K Metal enhancement
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial build of Swiftfin for iPhone and iPad. It retains Swiftfin's Jellyfin experience and adds an optional AVPlayer-based Anime4K Metal enhancement pipeline with automatic performance throttling, safety fallbacks, A/B comparison, and a performance monitor.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Swiftfin uses Bluetooth to discover nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Swiftfin uses Bluetooth to discover nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Swiftfin uses Face ID to lock and access local users.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Swiftfin uses the local network to connect to your Jellyfin server and discover Cast-enabled devices on your Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Swiftfin uses your location to identify the current Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Swiftfin uses the microphone to listen for ultrasonic tokens when pairing with nearby Cast devices.
